purpose: generic light/dark contrast fixtures for starter-icon optical review before Astral UI runtime support exists
scope_boundary: These colors are review fixtures, not the AnimeRPG final UI theme, not a renderer implementation, and not an accessibility certification.
color_space: sRGB hex values; relative luminance and contrast use the WCAG 2.2 sRGB formula

reference.threshold_note: Meaningful UI graphics and state cues target at least 3:1 against adjacent colors. Do not round a sub-3.0 result up to passing.

rules: The icon SVG remains currentColor-driven; semantic and theme color stay outside glyph geometry.
Every enabled icon role listed below must meet the 3:1 review threshold against both the theme canvas and default control surface.
Thin antialiased strokes can appear weaker than nominal color math; visual review at 16, 20, 24, 32, 48 and 64 px remains required.
Inactive/disabled styling is intentionally omitted from this acceptance fixture rather than using low contrast as a default design.
Focus treatment is a separate state cue and must remain distinguishable from its adjacent background in native Astral UI once that path exists.
next_acceptance: render the exact repository-head icon source against both reference themes with one accepted rasterizer
compare 16/20/24/32/48/64 px outputs for antialiasing, stroke loss and optical balance
repeat the same checks in native Astral UI after image import, tint, filtering and DPI behavior exist
keep final game theme approval separate from this generic starter calibration fixture
